notes.title: Linux Version and Small Patch
notes.content: [p]A Linux version has now been added! Hopefully everything works correctly.[/p][p][/p][p]I also fixed a couple of things I missed in the last v5 version (I left in an fps counter oops)[/p]

notes.title: v5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
-Fixed an issue where the screen would remain blurry after triggering a certain scene.
-Fixed an issue where Emi's Headpat ending name would not be displayed.
-Fixed an issue where Saty's headpat meter would not fills at a certain point.
-Updated the Auto Mode so it functions better with certain events.
-Updated the "Show More Text" arrow so it disappears in all scenarios of advancing dialogue when it isn't eneded.
-Changed the naming scheme for versions to integers instead of 1.1, 1.2, etc.

notes.title: v1.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed an audio bug with the main menu not adjusting volume levels in some situations.
[*]Fixed an issue with the headpat progress popups sometimes glitching positions.
[*]A few more typo fixes.
[*]Fixed how Steam achievements work so there's no more issues playing offline.
[*]Added a "more text" arrow for long dialogue lines that require clicking to read the rest.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.3
notes.content: Fixed a glitch that could cause headpat events to not work (Hopefully!!)

notes.title: v1.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed lots of typos.
[*]Made the headpat events much more noticeable and obvious that you need to do them for the true ending.
[*]Slightly altered the beginning of the true ending route so it flows nicer.
[*]Added headpat achievements.
[*]Added headpatting scene.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.1 Patch (Bug Fix)
notes.content:
There was a bug in the v1.0 release where after one ending, the player would get stuck on the title screen. This has been patched.



Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: New Release Date: August 22, 2025
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Unfortunately, some last minute things have popped up that warrant a couple of extra days to make sure everything is in working order. I'd rather move release back a couple days to ensure I can release the game in its best shape than release the game as-is. So the new release date is [b]August 22, 2025[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]I've reached out to Steam to try and change the official release date. I'm not quite sure how it works. But for now, the release is just going to say "August 2025" on the store page, as that's the best I can do on my end without them manually changing it. If they don't/can't change it, I'll still delay until the 22nd if I am able by not hitting the release button until then.[/p][p][/p][p]Sorry for the inconvenience, but it has to be done to make sure I deliver something I'm 100% satisfied with! Thank you for understanding.[/p][p]Kyuppin[/p]

notes.title: Textures Hotfix
notes.content: [p]I made a small oopsie woopsie when I released the demo. I accidentally forgot to compress the textures. Everything was left completely uncompressed in full 4096x4096, which, is kinda crazy, especially for a visual novel I suppose. ːlilypadwoahː[/p][p][/p][p]The game was actually using close to 4GB of VRAM because of this. (World's first AAA visual novel??) And I had one report of a crash when trying to load into the main scene.ːlilypaduguuː[/p][p][/p][p]But now everything is much more manageable. I went through every texture and added compression. Some individual textures went from 81MB to just 0.9MB which seems like magic to me. ːlilypadconfusedː Anyways, the game is now FEELS like it's running better than ever (probably placebo effect) but also the download size is less than half of what it was and VRAM usage is waaaaay down. ːlilypadhappyː You shouldn't even be able to notice a difference unless you're playing in 4k and you whip out a magnifying glass.[/p][p][/p][p]That's all! Yippee![/p][p][/p][p](Side note, I guess I should have done one of these announcement thingies when I released the demo, but I forgor they existed)[/p]
